jobs.title: Part-time Clerk/Company Secretary (remote working - apart from 4 meetings p.a.) - 3741
jobs.description:
Job Description

Our client is a charitable limited company with 7 Trustees, based in North Yorkshire. It holds a substantial amount of land and property for the benefit of the community.


The trustees are now looking for a Clerk/Company Secretary to the Trustees. This is a replacement role as the current incumbent is relocating out of the area. The role will be offered on a part-time basis of c.10 hours a week, so it would suit a candidate who is part or fully CGI qualified looking to add an extra client to a portfolio role perhaps. This role can largely be done remotely/ from home, as there is no formal office to be based at, however the quarterly Directors meetings are held face to face, so the ability to get to meetings in the Skipton area will be a practical consideration (meetings usually held Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct).


A full job description is available on request.


Duties will include;

  • Preparation of agenda for meetings and attendance at such meetings, preparing minutes on a timely basis for approval by the Chairman and circulation to the Board.
  • Implementation of decisions made by the Trustees at meetings where such decisions, which may relate to the formal business of the charity, are not delegated to the charity’s Managing Agents.
  • Provision of advice to the Trustees at Board meetings and, as necessary, in communications issued to consult and update the Trustees on a day-to-day basis in respect of the charity’s business, and in particular in the preparation of information and briefings required for effective decision-making by the Board.
  • Administration of the charity and the charitable company, liaising with and monitoring the implementation of decisions delegated to the Trust’s Managing Agents for land and property holdings.
  • Administration and management of payments systems, including issuing approved grant payments, from the Trust’s bank accounts, using the approved procedures with required dual signatory approvals.
  • In consultation with the Trust’s accountants, preparation of the Annual Return for the charity and of the statutory accounts for the company.
  • Carrying out administration for the successful running of the Trust as a charity and as a charitable limited company, including filing of documents and maintenance of the statutory records.
  • Administration of the charity’s website [and social media outlets], updating published information and posting items as appropriate, and preparing press releases as necessary in consultation with the Chairman of the Trustees.

jobs.title: Part-Time School Cleaner 0054
jobs.description:
Job Description

Hours: 25 hours per week, Mon-Fri 2pm-7pm

Aurora Ivy Lane School

We're an expanding specialist school providing education for young people aged 11 to 19 with complex care needs including behaviours that challenge and learning disabilities, often in association with autism spectrum conditions.  We work hard to ensure students have a holistic and supportive environment, enabling them to flourish and develop in all aspects of life. 

Based in Wakefield; we are currently looking to recruit a School Cleaner provide a cleaning service for the school across all types of rooms, including offices, classrooms, corridors, and toilets.

Key Duties: 

  • Vacuuming/cleaning floors.
  • Spot cleaning of spillages.
  • Wiping furniture, ledges, pipes, paintwork, doors and polishing door glass.
  • Emptying and cleaning bins (daily).
  • Cleaning toilets including sanitary fittings and surrounds.
  • Mopping and spray cleaning hard floor surfaces.
  • Wiping, dusting, cobweb removal, polishing.
  • Replenishing janitorial supplies in toilets, etc (daily).
  • Undertake deep clean as and when required.
  • Checking and closing windows, switching off lights after work and ensure the building is secure on exit.
  • Such other duties as may be allocated from time to time.

Like many SEN environments; your duties are likely to vary and therefore candidates will need to be flexible and be able to lend a hand whenever required.  

Job Description - School Cleaner

What we're looking for:

  • Some knowledge of Health and Safety Regulation in regards to cleaning equipment and cleaning materials.
  • Ability to work effectively and supportively as a member of the school team.
  • Ability to work with minimum supervision.
  • Ability to prioritise work and be flexible.
  • Experience of undertaking a range of cleaning duties.

How to apply:

You can apply online by completing our online application form. For more information on this position, please contact 

Successful applicants will be subject to pre-employment safeguarding checks including an enhanced disclosure and barring service (DBS) check.

The post is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 and the Aurora Group is therefore permitted to ask job applicants to declare all convictions and cautions (including those which are "spent" unless they are "protected" under the DBS filtering rules) in order to assess their suitability to work with children and young adults.

The Aurora Group is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of the children and young adults in our care and is a disability confident and equal opportunities employer.

This advert could be taken down at any point in time without prior notice if the position is filled.? 

Please note that candidates that are shortlisted might be subject to an online search.

jobs.title: Maths Teacher (Part time)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you believe that every student has the potential to master complex equations with the right guidance?

Can you turn a classroom into a hub of logical discovery and problem-solving?

Are you available to start your next challenge immediately?

About the Role

This is a part-time opportunity (3 days per week) starting as soon as possible. The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering engaging and comprehensive Mathematics lessons to students within a secondary setting. You will be stepping into a role that requires flexibility, creativity, and a deep commitment to student progression. Your goal will be to provide a supportive and challenging environment that fosters academic growth and confidence.

About the School

Located in Leeds , this school is renowned for its inclusive atmosphere and its dedication to removing barriers to learning. With industry-standard facilities and a focus on both academic and vocational excellence, it offers a vibrant and diverse environment for both staff and students. The school prides itself on being aspirational, collaborative, and deeply respectful of individuality, ensuring that every member of the community has the tools they need to succeed.

Requirements

  • Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) or an equivalent recognised teaching qualification.
  • An Enhanced DBS on the update service (or willingness to apply for one).
  • Strong subject knowledge across algebra, geometry, statistics, and calculus.
  • Eligibility to work in the UK.
Skills
  • Patience: The ability to explain complex concepts in multiple ways until they "click."
  • Adaptability: Tailoring teaching styles to meet the diverse needs of learners.
  • Organisation: Efficiently managing lesson planning, marking, and admin duties.
  • Problem-Solving: Finding creative solutions to engage reluctant learners.
  • Classroom Management: Maintaining a calm and focused atmosphere.
  • IT Literacy: Proficient use of educational technology and Microsoft Office.
Responsibilities
  • Plan and deliver high-quality, inclusive Mathematics lessons across various levels.
  • Develop innovative schemes of work and teaching resources tailored to student needs.
  • Assess, mark, and provide constructive feedback on student work to drive improvement.
  • Monitor and track student progress, maintaining accurate records of achievement.
  • Manage classroom behaviour effectively to ensure a productive learning environment.
  • Prepare students for national qualifications and external examinations.
  • Lead strategies to improve student retention, attendance, and success rates.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to develop curriculum and share best practices.
  • Act as a role model, promoting a positive image of the college at all times.
  • Comply with all safeguarding, equality, and professional ethics standards.

What We Offer:

  • A supportive, collaborative working environment.
  • Opportunities for career progression and ongoing professional development.
  • The chance to make a significant impact on the lives of students.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • A Refer a Friend scheme where you could earn a £300 Love2shop voucher (subject to terms and conditions).

Could this be the ideal role for you?Click "Apply Now" to submit your application for the role of a Maths Teacher. For more information, please contact or call to speak to the secondary team.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - Part-time, Contract or Full-time. Remote or Hybrid
jobs.description:
Job Description

Sales Development Representative - Part-time, Contract or Full-time. Remote or Hybrid


At FISCAL Technologies, we're not just selling software – we're partnering with finance leaders to protect over £350 billion global spend every year through innovative AI-driven solutions that deliver ROI within three months.


We need passionate relationship builders who can open doors, book meetings and help develop sales opportunities.


As a Sales Development Representative focusing on booking new business meetings, you'll work directly with our new business sales team and marketing teams.


  • Prospecting and lead generation: Identify and research potential customers who are a good fit for the company's products or services.
  • Outbound outreach: Initiate contact with potential leads through various channels including phone calls, emails, and social media platforms.
  • Lead qualification: Qualify leads based on predefined criteria to ensure they have the interest, budget, and need for the company's offerings.
  • Booking meetings: Schedule and book qualified meetings or product demonstrations for Account Executives.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with sales and marketing teams to align on strategies and messaging.


Required skills and qualifications

  • Communication: Excellent verbal, written, and listening skills are crucial for building rapport and making a strong first impression.
  • Organisation and time management: Must be able to manage a high volume of tasks, organize leads, and prioritize daily activities efficiently.
  • Tech-savviness: Proficiency with CRM systems and other sales tools is essential for success.
  • Persistence and motivation: Ability to work in a target-driven environment and stay motivated through consistent outreach efforts.


Why Join FISCAL?

  • Competitive salary and flexibility
  • Be part of an exciting growth company protecting organisations around the world.
  • Make a Difference: Our solutions deliver meaningful impact for finance teams worldwide
  • Growth Opportunity: Join a growing company with ambitious plans where your contributions matter


FISCAL Technologies is proud to be a previous recipient of the Queen's Award for Innovation and recognised as a great place to work. We're committed to building a diverse team that reflects the clients we serve.
